description: One-variable-at-a-time live comparisons. Baseline is the effective production configuration loaded by SignPipeline.

gate.comparison: paired per-session macro WER delta versus baseline
gate.pass: max(session_delta) <= maximum_session_worsening AND mean(session_delta) < -minimum_mean_improvement AND accepted_precision >= minimum_accepted_precision

selection_policy.tau_accept: Set pipeline.cal['tau_accept'] directly; do not apply max() with spotting.accept_min.
